title: Deduplicated object batch with demand-driven clean-state scan
failure_signature: A batched manifest validator still timed out because it requested overlapping blobs twice and ran a full worktree status scan when clean state was not part of the candidate-stage contract.
candidate_workaround: Deduplicate object specifications before one cat-file batch and run full worktree status only when require-clean is true.
recurrence_guard: Remove duplicate process and object work without removing any requested byte comparison; preserve the clean scan whenever the validation stage requires it.
rollback: Retain both timeouts and the failed M10 witness, restore per-entry reads if batch parsing changes bytes, and rerun the same hashes under a larger observable envelope only if needed.
scope_boundary: Validation efficiency only; deduplication cannot reduce manifest entries, privacy classes, or required clean-state evidence.
